svg.aria-label: The rows of t5-small's embedding matrix, not to scale. Rows 0 to 31,999 are the SentencePiece vocabulary, from the padding, end and unknown tokens to the last piece. Rows 32,000 to 32,099 are the 100 sentinels, extra_id_99 down to extra_id_0. Rows 32,100 to 32,127 are 28 rows that no token uses, left over because the matrix was rounded up to a multiple of 128. The new token for less-than takes row 32,100

svg.text: Where a new token can go: the rows of T5's embedding matrix
32,128 rows, of which the tokenizer uses 32,100; not to scale
rows 0–31,999: <pad>, </s>, <unk>, then pieces of English, German, French, Romanian
rows 32,100–32,127: no token uses them; the matrix was rounded up to 251 × 128 rows
the new token '<' takes row 32,100, the first free one
